integrity: The exact coefficients and finite experiments are independently reproducible with the embedded Python standard-library programs. Finite checks do not establish the general theorem, for which a mathematical proof is supplied. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite generalized theta networks with at least three internally disjoint paths and path lengths at least two; activity rates and initial-state populations only, not primitive temporal-cycle populations or transient-entry-time distributions.
Uses the already published finite-graph cycle-mean activity theorem of Gravner, Lyu and Sivakoff; that theorem is not claimed as new.
The Gaussian asymptotic requires a fixed number of paths and strictly positive finite limits of all relative lengths.
Some unindexed earlier equivalent enumeration may exist; independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Exact excitation-rate distributions and Gaussian range laws on generalized theta graphs
